files.token-1-mtp-hprev.f32: the target hidden after position 0, fed as h to the position-1 row
files.token-1-mtp-h.f32: the head's h_nextn at position 1 (nextn.post_projection of the output_norm'd hidden)

note: Captured on Metal with an F32 cache and flash attention off, one token per decode. The assistant context shares the target's layer-46 (sliding) and layer-47 (global) KV caches and writes none of its own; each row was captured before the target decoded that position, which is the driver's draft() moment. The target hidden is the output_norm-applied final hidden (llama_get_embeddings_nextn).
